### Existing Incident
- **Incident Slug / File:** (e.g. `2026-09-crowdstrike.md`)
- **Target Organization:** 

### Type of Update
- [ ] New milestone to add to timeline
- [ ] Status upgrade (e.g. `EMERGING` -> `ACKNOWLEDGED` or `CONFIRMED`)
- [ ] Incident debunked / refuted (`REFUTED`)
- [ ] Source link correction

### Milestone Details
- **Date & Time (UTC):** `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC`
- **Milestone Description:** 
- **Verification Tier:** 
  - [ ] 🟢 CONFIRMED BY REGULATOR (SEC 8-K, State AG, HHS, CISA)
  - [ ] 🟢 CONFIRMED BY TARGET (Official blog, status alert, PR)
  - [ ] 🟡 UNVERIFIED CLAIM (Dark web post, extortion site listing)
  - [ ] 🔵 INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION (Researcher audit, reputable report)
  - [ ] ⚪ REFUTED (Disproven / recycled data)
- **Primary Source Link:**
